standard_prerequisites.name: Characterization of quasi-affine morphisms
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces, Lemma spaces-morphisms-lemma-characterize-quasi-affine (cross-chapter, cited at ~3019-3021)
standard_prerequisites.use: Factorization X -> Z -> Y with X -> Z quasi-compact open immersion and Z -> Y affine.

standard_prerequisites.name: Affine morphisms are limits of fp affines
standard_prerequisites.use: Z = lim Z_i with Z_i affine fp over Y.

standard_prerequisites.name: Opens descend to finite stages and eventual closedness
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-descend-opens (same chapter, cited at ~3024-3026); lemma-finite-type-eventually-closed (same chapter, cited at ~3029-3031)
standard_prerequisites.use: X is the inverse image of a quasi-compact open U_0 in Z_0; X -> U_i is a closed immersion for i large.

core_obligations: 分解与极限：经具名刻画引理分解 X→Z→Y（X→Z 拟紧开浸入、Z→Y 仿射）；Z=lim Z_i（affine fp，引 affine-morphism-is-limit）（~3019-3023 行）。
三步收尾：descend-opens 取 U_0⊂Z_0 使 X≅U_0 在 Z 中的原像，U_i 为其在 Z_i 中的原像且 U=lim U_i；finite-type-eventually-closed 给大 i 使 X→U_i 闭浸入；取 X'=U_i 即得（~3024-3033 行）。
proof_roadmap: 拟仿射分解 + 仿射 fp 极限（~3019-3023 行）。
开恢复 + eventual closedness 收尾（~3024-3033 行）。
difficulty_reason: 四步极限组装（分解 + fp 逼近 + 开恢复 + eventual closedness）全程展示；策略真实。
